table.name: date_dim
table.summary: The 'date_dim' table appears to be a dimension table that contains detailed information about dates, including date identifiers, day-of-week, month, quarter, year, and related metadata. It is likely used in a data warehouse for time-based analysis and reporting.

d_date_sk.name: d_date_sk
d_date_sk.meaning: A unique surrogate key for the date record.

d_date_id.name: d_date_id
d_date_id.meaning: A unique identifier for the date, likely a business or system-specific code.

d_date.name: d_date
d_date.meaning: The actual date value in a standard date format.

d_month_seq.name: d_month_seq
d_month_seq.meaning: A sequence number representing the month within a year.

d_week_seq.name: d_week_seq
d_week_seq.meaning: A sequence number representing the week within a year.

d_quarter_seq.name: d_quarter_seq
d_quarter_seq.meaning: A sequence number representing the quarter within a year.

d_year.name: d_year
d_year.meaning: The year associated with the date.

d_dow.name: d_dow
d_dow.meaning: The day of the week (e.g., 1 for Monday, 2 for Tuesday, etc.).

d_moy.name: d_moy
d_moy.meaning: The month of the year (e.g., 1 for January, 2 for February, etc.).

d_dom.name: d_dom
d_dom.meaning: The day of the month (e.g., 1 for the first day, 2 for the second day, etc.).

d_qoy.name: d_qoy
d_qoy.meaning: The quarter of the year (e.g., 1 for the first quarter, 2 for the second quarter, etc.).

d_fy_year.name: d_fy_year
d_fy_year.meaning: The fiscal year associated with the date.

d_fy_quarter_seq.name: d_fy_quarter_seq
d_fy_quarter_seq.meaning: A sequence number representing the fiscal quarter within the fiscal year.

d_fy_week_seq.name: d_fy_week_seq
d_fy_week_seq.meaning: A sequence number representing the fiscal week within the fiscal year.

d_day_name.name: d_day_name
d_day_name.meaning: The name of the day of the week (e.g., Monday, Tuesday, etc.).

d_quarter_name.name: d_quarter_name
d_quarter_name.meaning: The name of the quarter (e.g., 1900Q1, 1900Q2, etc.).

d_holiday.name: d_holiday
d_holiday.meaning: Indicates whether the date is a holiday (e.g., 'Y' for yes, 'N' for no).

d_weekend.name: d_weekend
d_weekend.meaning: Indicates whether the date is a weekend (e.g., 'Y' for yes, 'N' for no).

d_following_holiday.name: d_following_holiday
d_following_holiday.meaning: Indicates whether the following date is a holiday (e.g., 'Y' for yes, 'N' for no).

d_first_dom.name: d_first_dom
d_first_dom.meaning: The first day of the month as a surrogate key.

d_last_dom.name: d_last_dom
d_last_dom.meaning: The last day of the month as a surrogate key.

d_same_day_ly.name: d_same_day_ly
d_same_day_ly.meaning: The surrogate key for the same day in the previous year.

d_same_day_lq.name: d_same_day_lq
d_same_day_lq.meaning: The surrogate key for the same day in the previous quarter.

d_current_day.name: d_current_day
d_current_day.meaning: Indicates whether the date is the current day (e.g., 'Y' for yes, 'N' for no).

d_current_week.name: d_current_week
d_current_week.meaning: Indicates whether the date is in the current week (e.g., 'Y' for yes, 'N' for no).

d_current_month.name: d_current_month
d_current_month.meaning: Indicates whether the date is in the current month (e.g., 'Y' for yes, 'N' for no).

d_current_quarter.name: d_current_quarter
d_current_quarter.meaning: Indicates whether the date is in the current quarter (e.g., 'Y' for yes, 'N' for no).

d_current_year.name: d_current_year
d_current_year.meaning: Indicates whether the date is in the current year (e.g., 'Y' for yes, 'N' for no).
